(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix webhook. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/coralogix-Webhook-extension/."
custom  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Generic webhook."
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.slack,<.pager_duty,<.sendlog,<.email_group,<.microsoft_teams,<.microsoft_teams_workflow,<.jira,<.opsgenie,<.demisto,<.event_bridge]"
custom.headers  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Webhook headers. Map of string to string. A header carrying a secret belongs in `headers_wo` instead, so its value is never written to state."
custom.headers_wo  MapAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Webhook headers whose values are secret, keyed by header name. Values are sent to Coralogix and never written to state. Every key needs a matching entry in `headers_wo_versions`, and a key here must not also appear in `headers`. Terraform never stores a write-only value, so it cannot detect that the secret changed: increment `headers_wo_versions` to send a rotated one. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Importing brings the value into state, because an import has neither configuration nor prior state to say the value is managed this way; one apply afterwards removes it again, so treat an imported secret as exposed and rotate it. Reading the same webhook through `data.coralogix_webhook` does return this value, because a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only."
custom.headers_wo_versions  MapAttribute optional elem=basetypes.Int64Type
    markdown: "Version of each `headers_wo` value, keyed by header name. Increment a header's version to send a rotated secret."
custom.method  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Webhook method. can be one of: get, post, put"
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["get" "post" "put"]

jira.api_token_wo  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Jira API token, sent to Coralogix and never written to state. Terraform never stores a write-only value, so it cannot detect that the secret changed: increment `api_token_wo_version` to send a rotated one. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Importing brings the value into state, because an import has neither configuration nor prior state to say the value is managed this way; one apply afterwards removes it again, so treat an imported secret as exposed and rotate it. Reading the same webhook through `data.coralogix_webhook` does return this value, because a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only."
    validator: schemavalidator.AlsoRequiresValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, also these are set: "[<.api_token_wo_version]"
    validator: schemavalidator.ConflictsWithValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, these are not set: "[<.api_token]"

    markdown: "Version of `api_token_wo`. Increment it to send a rotated API token."
    validator: schemavalidator.AlsoRequiresValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, also these are set: "[<.api_token_wo]"
